title: Integrations
emailHint: Receive the daily report attachment. Uncheck to stop future emails or check to resume. An email already being sent may still arrive.
emailManaged: The recipient manages opt-in from their daily email settings.
emailAcceptanceNote: Email server acceptance does not confirm inbox receipt. Contact support to review a failed or uncertain send before retrying.
dailyOnly: Delivers daily stats. Weekly statistics are available in the dashboard only.
replaceEndpointHint: Leave blank to keep the saved URL. Its private path and any credentials are hidden. Enter the complete HTTPS URL to replace it. For security, re-enter a replacement URL after a failed save.
renameHint: Renaming does not interrupt delivery. Replacing the URL or changing reports will pause delivery until you test and reactivate it.
editRetestWarning: Saving these delivery changes will pause this webhook and clear its previous test approval. Send a new successful sample test, then reactivate it. A delivery already in progress may still finish using the previous settings.

guide.title: How to connect your automation service
steps: Create a receiving webhook in a service you control. Copy its public HTTPS URL.
Add the address, a name and purpose, and choose an authorized responsible user. Daily stats delivery starts paused.
Send a sample test and check the final destination. Sample values are synthetic, not market data. Configure your automation to display the report fields.
Acknowledge the licensed-use warning, then activate future delivery. Keep all recipients within your licensed audience. Pause or remove the integration when it is no longer needed.
guide.format: We send JSON report data, not a PDF attachment. Existing report fields remain at the top level and are also available inside data. eventId identifies the event for duplicate detection; test identifies synthetic samples.
guide.authentication: The receiving endpoint must accept an HTTPS JSON POST without custom authentication headers. Signed payloads and custom header credentials are not supported. Keep the webhook URL private.
guide.dashboard: Map dashboardUrl into a link labeled with dashboardLinkLabel, and include licensedUseNotice in your message. Daily stats link to the matching day; samples link to the dashboard. Sign-in and licensed access are required. The link itself does not grant access.

sharingWarning: You are responsible for where this integration sends Harper Vance data. Sharing or forwarding it to anyone not authorized under your organization's license, including through automation services, violates our service terms.
sharingAcknowledge: I understand and will limit delivery to recipients authorized under our organization's license.
testRequired: Send a successful sample test before activation. Webhook acceptance does not confirm downstream receipt.
allowanceHint: Shared across your organization. Paused destinations count; removed destinations free a slot.
allowanceUnavailable: Destination allowance is unavailable. Refresh or contact support.
intro: Manage daily report emails and daily stats webhooks. Weekly statistics stay in the dashboard.
platformIntro: Review integrations across organizations and responsible users.

errors.ACKNOWLEDGMENT_REQUIRED: Acknowledge the licensed-use warning before activation.
errors.NOT_ENTITLED: Your current license does not include this integration.
errors.LIMIT_REACHED: Your organization has reached its integration limit.
errors.INVALID_ENDPOINT: Enter a public HTTPS webhook address using the standard HTTPS port.
errors.INVALID_OWNER: Choose an active organization owner or administrator.
errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Secure integration setup is not available yet. Contact support.

selectOrganization: Select an organization to add or manage integrations.
noOrganization: No organization management access is available.
name: Integration name
endpointHint: Saved securely. The full address will not be displayed after saving. Your receiving service controls any further processing or delivery.
pausedHint: New integrations start paused. Test the connection, then activate it to receive future reports.
external: This existing webhook is listed for visibility only. Its original configuration controls delivery. This page does not change its schedule or show its live delivery status or history.

confirmations.test: Send clearly labeled sample data to this destination now? This does not activate report delivery.
confirmations.active: Activate future report delivery to this destination?
confirmations.paused: Pause future delivery to this destination? A request already in progress may still finish.
confirmations.removed: Remove this integration? Delivery will stop, but audit and delivery history will be retained. This cannot be undone.

outcomes.uncertain: Delivery uncertain. Do not assume the message was not received.

acceptanceNote: Acceptance by the webhook does not confirm delivery to the final recipient. Check your receiving service to verify any further delivery.
apiHint: Eligible organizations can create read-only credentials. Copy a new credential once and keep it secure.
apiSecret: New credential. Copy now; it will not be shown again.
apiConfirmRevoke: Revoke this API credential? Clients using it will lose access.
notLicensed: Webhook setup requires a license that includes webhook access.
retryWarning: Retry this report delivery? The destination may have received the earlier attempt. Retrying can create a duplicate message.
retryUnavailable: This attempt cannot be retried or a retry was already requested.
